title: net1 v6 against net1 v5 on net1 v5's own ranges
description: Run 149 trained net1 v6 on net1 v5's data plus wider ranges (exp-data-net1-v6-146) and reported it against v5 on the union's validation and test links, where v5 is outside its range on the wide links. The choice rule in experiments/net1v6.json asks first whether v6 is no worse than v5 inside v5's ranges. This reports each of v6's three seeds and v5 (--compare) on the validation and test links of v5's own data only (exp-data-net1-broad-30s-73 and -60s-74, every 12th step, the split by link of net1_train.py, so these are links neither model trained on): 90% coverage, R^2 and log loss per LCF (net1_train.py --eval, no training).
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-v6-s$SEED-in-v5-range" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=0.05 --set width=512 --seed $SEED --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" --eval "$IN/v6/net1-v6-s$SEED/net1.pt" --compare "$IN/v5/net1-d0.05-w512-s0/net1.pt"
collect: for d in "$OUT"/net1-*; do cat "$d/summary.md"; echo; done > "$OUT/summary.md"
